en: A vintage black‑and‑white street view showing an urban scene with ornate multi‑storey buildings flanking a wide street. Horse‑drawn carriages and pedestrians move along the cobblestone road, and a tram can be seen in the distance. The architecture is late‑19th/early‑20th‑century eclectic style with decorated facades and towers. Printed in red at the top are the words identifying the city and street. Various shop signs in German are visible on the right side.
